connector.name: No Crd
connector.registryDescription: Dynamic pod spawner & proxy for ephemeral AI agent workspaces on Kubernetes without CRDs
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package no-crd. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nogoo9 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
